##### Project general facts

Vega is a residential tower by Acube Developments, named after the brightest star in the constellation of Lyra. The building rises above a multi-level parking podium and offers studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed to balance comfort, style and functionality. Inspired by nature, the project brings natural elements, greenery and open views into everyday living, creating a calm and restorative atmosphere. The design also follows Vastu principles and welcomes pets.

The amenity collection is extensive and focuses on wellness and recreation. Residents enjoy a sky pool, a pool deck lounge, a kids' pool, a waterfall and water cave, a rock oasis and a wellness garden with sensory water therapy. Separate saunas, jacuzzis and steam rooms for men and women ensure privacy. Active residents have a fully equipped gym, a CrossFit area, a Pilates studio, an outdoor yoga studio, a jogging track, a pickleball court, net cricket and table tennis. Families and social life are covered by indoor and outdoor play areas, a toddler zone, a children's library, a gamers' lounge, a co-working lounge, an outdoor cinema and a multi-function hall.

Interiors combine modern finishes and high-quality materials with a clean, contemporary aesthetic. Apartments are delivered fully equipped and furnished as smart homes, allowing residents to control their environment with a single touch. Kitchens are fully fitted for everyday use. Building security includes facial recognition access, an automatic number plate recognition system, round-the-clock security and electric vehicle charging points.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Sports City is a master-planned community in the south-west of Dubai, built around world-class sporting venues such as the Dubai International Cricket Stadium and The Els Club golf course. It combines apartments and villas with landscaped parks and green spaces, creating an active, family-friendly environment. The neighbourhood borders Motor City, Arjan, Jumeirah Village Circle and Jumeirah Village Triangle, giving residents a wide choice of services close to home.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect the community with Dubai Marina, Al Barsha, Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. City Centre Me'aisem sits right next door, while Dubai Hills Mall, Mall of the Emirates and Ibn Battuta are a short drive away. Schools in the area include The Royal Grammar School, Dwight School Dubai and Sunmarke School, and healthcare is provided by Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, Saudi German Hospital and several medical centres nearby.

Dubai Sports City is a freehold community with steady demand from tenants who value its lifestyle, green spaces and easy reach to the city's main business hubs. Rental yields in the area are among the more attractive in Dubai, supported by a large base of young professionals and families. Good value compared with neighbouring communities makes it a popular choice for both investors and end users.
